title: Estate · noun
subtitle: 「屋苑／住宅區／住宅發展項目」，究竟是哪一種 estate？
description: 「屋苑／住宅區／住宅發展項目」，究竟是哪一種 estate？

words.note: 最直接的近義說法之一，表示由多幢住宅或多個住宅單位組成、通常有共同規劃的住宅區；比 estate 更透明，英美英語都容易理解。
words.example: The new housing complex includes several apartment blocks and a playground.
words.exampleZh: 新的住宅區包括數幢公寓大樓和一個遊樂場。

exercises.original: The new estate contains five apartment blocks, a playground, and shared parking.
exercises.zh: 這個新住宅區包括五幢公寓大樓、一個遊樂場和共用停車位。
exercises.upgrade: housing complex · 住宅區；住宅綜合體

options.explanation: mansion = mansion 是單幢豪宅，不能包含多幢 apartment blocks 作為一個住宅區。
district = district 範圍更廣，未必是一個共同規劃的住宅項目。
housing complex = 多幢住宅加共同設施，最直接就是 housing complex。
village = village 是聚落概念，不等於多幢住宅組成的發展項目。
industrial estate = 用途是工業，不是住宅。
apartment building = 只是一幢樓，而原句明確有 five apartment blocks。

exercises.original: Security staff patrol the estate at night and monitor the shared entrances.
exercises.zh: 保安員夜間巡邏住宅區，並監察共用入口。
exercises.upgrade: housing complex · 住宅區；住宅綜合體

options.explanation: property = property 可只是一個單位或一幅地，不足以表達整體住宅區。
neighbourhood = 可以很廣泛，但 shared entrances 暗示一個共同管理的住宅項目。
mansion = 單幢住宅不會有多個 shared entrances 供整區使用。
housing complex = 共同入口、保安和整體管理都符合 housing complex。
district = 太大、太一般。
industrial park = 用途錯誤。

exercises.original: Residents of the estate share a garden, laundry room, and bicycle storage area.
exercises.zh: 住宅區居民共用花園、洗衣房和單車儲存區。
exercises.upgrade: housing complex · 住宅區；住宅綜合體

options.explanation: village = 村莊不一定有共同管理的 shared facilities。
property = 不是單一 property。
apartment building = 若只有一幢樓才合適，但原句描述整個 estate。
district = 缺少共同設施管理意味。
housing complex = 整區居民共享多項設施，housing complex 很自然。
mansion = 完全不合。

words.note: 最常見、最中性的替換之一，強調經規劃和開發形成的住宅項目；常見於地產、城市規劃和新聞語境。
words.example: A large residential development is being built near the station.
words.exampleZh: 車站附近正在興建一個大型住宅發展項目。

exercises.original: A new estate is being built on former industrial land near the river.
exercises.zh: 河邊原工業用地正在興建一個新的住宅發展項目。
exercises.upgrade: residential development · 住宅發展項目；住宅區

options.explanation: neighbourhood = neighbourhood 通常不是『being built』的一個單一開發項目。
district = 範圍太廣，也不一定只有住宅用途。
mansion = 不是單幢豪宅。
residential development = being built + former industrial land 明確是地產開發語境，最自然用 residential development。
village = 未必具有村莊地位。
industrial estate = 原工業地正改建成住宅，不能仍稱 industrial estate。

exercises.original: The council approved the estate after reviewing traffic and school capacity.
exercises.zh: 市議會在檢視交通和學校容量後批准了這個住宅發展項目。
exercises.upgrade: residential development · 住宅發展項目；住宅區

options.explanation: property = council 通常不是批准一個普通 property 的整體 school/traffic impact。
neighbourhood = neighbourhood 不是規劃審批中的開發申請。
mansion = 規模與交通和學校容量評估不符。
district = 不是單一 development proposal。
residential development = 規劃審批、交通和學校容量都是 residential development 的典型線索。
apartment building = 可能只是其中一部分，原句影響範圍更大。

exercises.original: The developer plans to add two hundred homes to the estate.
exercises.zh: 發展商計劃在住宅發展項目中增加二百個住宅單位。
exercises.upgrade: residential development · 住宅發展項目；住宅區

options.explanation: village = developer 並不是在增加一個自然村落。
property = 兩百個 homes 顯然不是單一 property。
district = 不夠具體。
mansion = 不合數量。
industrial estate = 用途錯誤。
residential development = developer + 200 homes 最直接指大型 residential development。

words.note: 表示一組彼此相連或共同規劃的住宅建築和設施；比 housing complex 稍正式，也常見於國際英語。
words.example: The residential complex has its own gym and shared gardens.
words.exampleZh: 這個住宅綜合體設有自己的健身室和共用花園。

exercises.original: The estate includes several towers connected by landscaped walkways.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅綜合體包括數座由園景步道連接的大樓。
exercises.upgrade: residential complex · 住宅綜合體；住宅區

options.explanation: apartment building = several towers 表示不只一幢建築。
district = 太廣，缺少共同規劃的建築群意味。
village = 高樓建築群不自然稱 village。
mansion = 完全不合。
residential complex = 多座 towers 加統一 landscaping，最適合 residential complex。
property = 太籠統。

exercises.original: The estate has controlled access and a shared fitness centre.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅綜合體設有出入管制和共用健身中心。
exercises.upgrade: residential complex · 住宅綜合體；住宅區

options.explanation: neighbourhood = 一般 neighbourhood 未必有 controlled access 和共同健身中心。
district = 不合封閉管理語境。
mansion = 不是單一豪宅。
industrial estate = 用途錯誤。
apartment building = 可以有 gym，但原句的 estate 指整個建築群。
residential complex = controlled access + shared fitness centre 強烈指向共同管理的 residential complex。

exercises.original: A management company maintains the estate's gardens and common areas.
exercises.zh: 管理公司負責住宅綜合體的花園和公共區域。
exercises.upgrade: residential complex · 住宅綜合體；住宅區

options.explanation: residential complex = 統一管理 gardens/common areas 很符合 residential complex。
village = 村莊公共空間通常不是由同一 management company 統一維護。
property = 單一 property 不足以表達整區 common areas。
district = 不合單一管理主體。
mansion = 不合。
industrial park = 用途錯誤。

words.note: 與 residential development 接近，特別強調新建住宅項目本身；常見於規劃、建築和地方新聞。
words.example: The council approved a new housing development on the edge of town.
words.exampleZh: 市議會批准在城鎮邊緣興建新的住宅發展項目。

exercises.original: The estate will provide eighty new homes for local families.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅發展項目將為本地家庭提供八十個新住宅單位。
exercises.upgrade: housing development · 住宅發展項目

options.explanation: district = 不是整個行政或城市地區。
neighbourhood = 可能日後形成 neighbourhood，但建設項目本身是 development。
mansion = 單幢豪宅不可能等於 eighty homes。
property = 太小。
village = 沒有村莊行政／聚落含義。
housing development = 明確說 will provide 80 new homes，這是典型 housing development。

exercises.original: Construction on the estate is expected to begin next spring.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅發展項目的工程預計明年春季展開。
exercises.upgrade: housing development · 住宅發展項目

options.explanation: housing development = construction ... begin 是住宅項目語境，因此 housing development 最自然。
neighbourhood = neighbourhood 本身通常不以單一 construction start 描述。
property = 規模過小且太一般。
district = 不是一個單一工程項目。
mansion = 沒有大型項目線索。
industrial estate = 用途不合。

exercises.original: Local residents objected to the size of the proposed estate.
exercises.zh: 本地居民反對擬建住宅發展項目的規模。
exercises.upgrade: housing development · 住宅發展項目

options.explanation: village = proposed village 可能存在，但沒有住宅開發規劃的精確感。
housing development = proposed + public objection + size 是典型規劃語境。
district = 通常不是由 developer 提出的單一 proposal。
property = 無法解釋 size 引起社區規劃爭議。
mansion = 範圍過窄。
apartment building = 原句 estate 可含多類住宅，不一定單一樓宇。

words.note: 在英式英語中非常接近 housing estate，表示一大片共同規劃的住宅區；比單獨 estate 更明確。
words.example: The school serves families from a nearby residential estate.
words.exampleZh: 這所學校為附近住宅屋苑的家庭提供服務。

exercises.original: The school draws most of its pupils from the estate nearby.
exercises.zh: 這所學校大部分學生來自附近的住宅屋苑。
exercises.upgrade: residential estate · 住宅屋苑；住宅區

options.explanation: residential estate = 學校服務附近大型住宅區時，residential estate 很自然。
industrial estate = 工業區不是家庭主要居住地。
district = 範圍可以更大，沒有 estate 的明確住宅開發感。
mansion = 一幢豪宅不可能提供大部分 pupils。
property = 太小。
apartment building = 也可能有學生，但規模通常不足以解釋 most pupils。

exercises.original: A bus route connects the estate with the town centre.
exercises.zh: 巴士路線連接住宅屋苑與市中心。
exercises.upgrade: residential estate · 住宅屋苑；住宅區

options.explanation: property = 巴士路線不會為單一 property 作這種區域連接描述。
residential estate = 巴士連接一整個住宅區和 town centre，residential estate 很合適。
mansion = 不合。
industrial estate = 若是住宅居民則用途錯誤。
apartment building = 通常會說 stop near the building，而非整區 route connection。
village = 原句沒有獨立聚落身份。

exercises.original: The estate was built in the 1970s and contains a mixture of houses and flats.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅屋苑建於一九七〇年代，內有獨立屋和公寓。
exercises.upgrade: residential estate · 住宅屋苑；住宅區

options.explanation: apartment complex = 有 houses and flats，並非純公寓。
mansion = 不合多種住宅。
residential estate = 同一時期規劃興建、同時包含 houses and flats，最自然是 residential estate。
district = 沒有整體 built in the 1970s 的單一發展感。
property = 太小。
industrial estate = 用途不合。

words.note: 英式英語中的核心說法，通常指由多幢住宅組成、整體規劃的住宅區；和這一義項的 estate 幾乎完全對應。
words.example: Many families moved into the new housing estate in the 1990s.
words.exampleZh: 很多家庭在一九九〇年代遷入這個新屋苑。

exercises.original: Thousands of people live on the estate at the edge of the city.
exercises.zh: 數千人住在城市邊緣的屋苑。
exercises.upgrade: housing estate · 屋苑；住宅區

options.explanation: mansion = 單幢豪宅不可能容納數千人。
housing estate = 英式英語中大型共同規劃住宅區最核心的說法就是 housing estate。
property = 單一 property 規模不符。
industrial estate = 不是居住用途。
apartment building = 一幢樓通常不足以涵蓋 estate。
district = 可以有數千人，但沒有共同住宅發展的含義。

exercises.original: The estate was developed by the local authority after the war.
exercises.zh: 這個屋苑在戰後由地方政府發展興建。
exercises.upgrade: housing estate · 屋苑；住宅區

options.explanation: neighbourhood = 自然 neighbourhood 不一定由 local authority 整體 developed。
village = 不合戰後公共住宅開發語境。
housing estate = local authority + post-war development 是典型英式 housing estate 語境。
mansion = 不合。
property = 規模太小。
industrial estate = 用途錯誤。

exercises.original: There are two primary schools and several shops within the estate.
exercises.zh: 屋苑內有兩所小學和數間商店。
exercises.upgrade: housing estate · 屋苑；住宅區

options.explanation: apartment building = 單幢樓通常不會包含兩所 primary schools。
property = 不合大規模設施。
mansion = 完全不合。
housing estate = 屋苑內有學校和商店，顯示規模大且有完整社區設施。
industrial estate = 學校和居民商店配置顯示住宅用途。
street = 單一街道也不等於整個規劃屋苑。

words.note: 當 estate 不只強調建築物，也強調居民共同生活的社區環境時可用；比 housing estate 更有人群和社區感。
words.example: The area has grown into a large residential community.
words.exampleZh: 該區已發展成一個大型住宅社區。

exercises.original: The estate has developed a strong sense of community among long-term residents.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅社區的長期居民建立了很強的社區歸屬感。
exercises.upgrade: residential community · 住宅社區

options.explanation: property = 單一物業無法表達居民群體。
apartment building = 可能有居民社群，但原句 estate 的範圍更廣。
residential community = 句子強調 residents 和 sense of community，因此 residential community 最貼切。
industrial estate = 不合 residential residents。
mansion = 不合。
district = 太廣，且未必以居民共同生活為核心。

exercises.original: The estate organizes regular events for families and older residents.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅社區定期為家庭和年長居民舉辦活動。
exercises.upgrade: residential community · 住宅社區

options.explanation: housing project = 可指發展項目，但句子重點是居民社區活動，而不是建設本身。
property = 不合居民群體。
mansion = 不合。
residential community = 定期為不同居民群體辦活動時，residential community 比純建築詞更自然。
industrial estate = 用途錯誤。
district = 可以辦活動，但沒有 estate 的住宅社區焦點。

exercises.original: Many residents have lived on the estate for more than twenty years.
exercises.zh: 很多居民在這個住宅社區已居住超過二十年。
exercises.upgrade: residential community · 住宅社區

options.explanation: mansion = 不合大量 residents。
property = 太小。
industrial estate = 不是住宅居住語境。
apartment building = 原句沒有只限一幢樓。
residential community = 長期居住人口和社區延續性使 residential community 很自然。
construction site = 已長期居住，顯然不是工地。

words.note: 當 estate 是按整體設計興建、包含道路、住宅和公共設施的規劃住宅區時可用；比一般 residential development 更強調整體規劃。
words.example: The planned community includes schools, parks, and local shops.
words.exampleZh: 這個規劃社區包括學校、公園和本地商店。

exercises.original: The estate was designed with schools, parks, shops, and walking routes from the beginning.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅區從一開始便整體規劃學校、公園、商店和步行路線。
exercises.upgrade: planned community · 規劃社區

options.explanation: neighbourhood = 一般 neighbourhood 未必是 from the beginning 整體設計。
district = 範圍概念太一般。
property = 無法包含完整公共設施網絡。
planned community = designed ... from the beginning + 多種設施是 planned community 的核心線索。
mansion = 不合。
apartment building = 規模不符。

exercises.original: The estate was built in phases according to a single master plan.
exercises.zh: 這個規劃社區按照同一份總體規劃分階段興建。
exercises.upgrade: planned community · 規劃社區

options.explanation: village = 村落可以有規劃，但 single master plan 更直接指 planned community。
property = 不合多階段大型發展。
district = 不是單一 master-planned project。
industrial estate = 用途不合住宅。
planned community = single master plan 是 planned community 的直接定義線索。
mansion = 不合。

exercises.original: Residents can reach most daily services without leaving the estate.
exercises.zh: 居民毋須離開規劃社區便可使用大部分日常服務。
exercises.upgrade: planned community · 規劃社區

options.explanation: apartment building = 單幢樓不會通常包含 most daily services。
property = 規模太小。
mansion = 不合。
industrial estate = 不是居民日常生活服務。
street = 單一街道不等於完整規劃社區。
planned community = 把住宅、商店和服務整體納入同一區域，是 planned community 的典型特徵。

words.meaning: 公寓住宅區；公寓綜合體
words.note: 當 estate 主要由多幢公寓樓組成時可用；這是情境化近義詞，若住宅區以獨立屋為主則不適合。
words.example: The apartment complex contains six towers and underground parking.
words.exampleZh: 這個公寓住宅區有六座大樓和地下停車場。

exercises.original: The estate consists of six high-rise apartment towers around a central courtyard.
exercises.zh: 這個公寓住宅區由六幢高層公寓大樓圍繞中央庭院組成。
exercises.upgrade: apartment complex · 公寓住宅區；公寓綜合體

options.explanation: housing estate = 可以較廣泛地成立，但原句明確全部由 apartment towers 組成，apartment complex 更精確。
mansion = 不合六幢高樓。
district = 太廣。
property = 不合大型建築群。
apartment complex = 全部由多幢 apartment towers 組成時，apartment complex 最精確。
village = 不合高層公寓建築群。

exercises.original: A swimming pool and gym are shared by everyone living in the estate.
exercises.zh: 公寓住宅區所有居民共用泳池和健身室。
exercises.upgrade: apartment complex · 公寓住宅區；公寓綜合體

options.explanation: apartment building = 若有多幢住宅及共同設施，complex 比單一 building 更合適。
district = 一般 district 不會共用單一 pool/gym。
property = 太籠統。
mansion = 不合多人共同住宅。
industrial estate = 用途錯誤。
apartment complex = 多幢公寓共用 pool/gym 是 apartment complex 的典型情境。

exercises.original: The estate has underground parking beneath all four apartment blocks.
exercises.zh: 這個公寓住宅區的四幢公寓大樓下方設有地下停車場。
exercises.upgrade: apartment complex · 公寓住宅區；公寓綜合體

options.explanation: apartment complex = 四幢 apartment blocks 加統一地下停車場，最自然是 apartment complex。
mansion = 不合四幢 apartment blocks。
property = 不合大型共同設施。
village = 不合。
district = 沒有同一地下停車系統的整體管理感。
industrial estate = 不合住宅用途。

words.note: 英式英語中可指由政府、地方機構或發展商規劃的住宅項目；在部分地區也直接指已建成的住宅區。
words.example: The housing scheme was designed to provide affordable homes for local families.
words.exampleZh: 這個住宅計劃旨在為本地家庭提供可負擔住房。

exercises.original: The council launched the estate to provide affordable homes for low-income families.
exercises.zh: 市議會推出這個住宅計劃，為低收入家庭提供可負擔住房。
exercises.upgrade: housing scheme · 住宅計劃；屋邨

options.explanation: mansion = 完全不合 affordable homes for many families。
district = 不是 council launched 的單一住宅計劃。
neighbourhood = neighbourhood 通常不會被『launched』。
property = 規模太小。
industrial estate = 用途錯誤。
housing scheme = council launched + affordable homes 是典型 housing scheme 語境。

exercises.original: The estate includes a mix of subsidized and market-rate homes.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅計劃包括資助房屋和市價住宅。
exercises.upgrade: housing scheme · 住宅計劃；屋邨

options.explanation: housing scheme = subsidized and market-rate homes 強調政策／發展安排，housing scheme 很自然。
apartment building = 原句是多種住宅政策安排，不只一幢樓。
mansion = 不合。
district = 不夠具體。
property = 太小。
village = 沒有住宅政策項目含義。

exercises.original: Applications for homes on the estate are handled by the local housing authority.
exercises.zh: 這個住宅計劃的住房申請由地方房屋機構處理。
exercises.upgrade: housing scheme · 住宅計劃；屋邨

options.explanation: neighbourhood = 一般 neighbourhood 不會由 housing authority 統一處理入住申請。
housing scheme = housing authority + applications 表示公共／制度化住宅項目，最適合 housing scheme。
property = 不是單一物業申請。
district = 不合。
mansion = 不合。
industrial estate = 用途錯誤。

falseSynonyms.zh: 豪宅不等於 estate 的住宅區義 mansion 是一幢大型豪華住宅；這裡的 estate 指整片共同規劃的住宅區。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A mansion is one large house; a housing estate contains many homes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 物業不等於整個住宅區 property 可以是一幢房屋、一幅土地或法律上的資產；estate 在這個義項中指一整個住宅發展區。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A property may be a single home; an estate is a larger residential area.

falseSynonyms.zh: 社區不一定是規劃屋苑 neighbourhood 是較廣泛的地理／社區概念，可以自然形成；estate 通常是一個較明確、整體開發的住宅項目。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A neighbourhood may grow naturally; an estate is usually a defined residential development.

falseSynonyms.zh: 村莊不等於住宅屋苑 village 是一個聚落或行政／地理社區；estate 是住宅開發區，未必有村莊身份。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A village is a settlement; a housing estate is a residential development.

falseSynonyms.zh: 地區範圍太廣 district 可以包括住宅、商業、工業等不同用途；estate 在此只指特定住宅區。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A district can contain many types of land use; an estate is specifically residential here.

falseSynonyms.zh: 單幢公寓樓不等於 estate apartment building 是一幢建築；estate 通常包含多幢住宅、道路和公共空間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An apartment building is one building; an estate may contain many buildings and facilities.

falseSynonyms.zh: 工業區不是住宅 estate industrial estate 指工業園區；和這裡的住宅 estate 在用途上完全不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An industrial estate contains businesses or factories; a housing estate contains homes.

falseSynonyms.zh: estate 與 real estate 意思不同 real estate 指房地產作為財產或行業；estate 在這裡則指一個具體住宅區。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Real estate refers to property or the property business; a housing estate is a residential area.
